clues.text: People planned a city with a tower reaching to the heavens, to make a name for themselves.
At this place the LORD confused the language of the whole world.
From this place the LORD scattered the people over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
The builders of this city and tower used baked brick instead of stone and tar instead of mortar.
As people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
The LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
The LORD said that, as one people with one language, nothing they devised would be beyond them.
